The main takeaway from our work is that

subtidal reefs should be deployed in areas where they are likely to be colonized by native bivalves and that the reef should be constructed of a material that will not be a liability in the environment, i.e., it should not be a pollutant, it should not leach toxic materials and should be biocompatible.
